g.text: 4810: does fine-tuning change the signal under identical text?

g.text: 119 tasks x 2 source texts x 2 replayed models | layer 16 | existing activations only | CPU

g.text: One shared latent: z = TopK100(ReLU(u_base + u_FT + b)), with u_model = w_model dot h_model.

g.text: The two u terms below are contributions to one encoder, NOT independent sparse feature activations.

g.text: Near the marker: own-branch decoder cosine is lower in FT in 113/119 tasks.

g.text: Same fixed decoder direction: lower in 119/119 (base reference) or 111/119 (FT reference).

g.text: The local model contrast is also more negative than the contrast outside the window.

g.text: A smaller representation under forced text does not prove that this feature mediates the behavioral improvement.
